commits.message: Implement Firecrawl rotation logic and update job scraping process

Add job board API clients and scraping functionality  - Implemented Ashby Job Board API client for structured JSON job fetching. - Added Firecrawl-based extraction for non-standard ATS career pages, improving resilience against page redesigns. - Created Greenhouse Job Board API client to fetch job listings in a structured format. - Developed Lever Postings API client to retrieve job postings from Lever. - Introduced LinkedIn guest-API scraper to broaden job search capabilities globally. - Added unit tests for freshness and deadline parsing to ensure accurate job data handling.
Added README.md file for Maximum Product of Two Digits
